bio: Hi all! My name is Noël Grisanti (she/her). I grew up in New York City but have called New England home for the last decade and am so excited to welcome you to your life at Harvard. I am a third year Master of Divinity student at Harvard Divinity School where I study social justice ministry – in particular, the role of faith communities at the intersection of racial, economic and climate justice. I love travel, crosswords, museums, red pandas and Frank’s Red hot sauce. I live with my husband, Max. I can’t wait to meet you! Community Yards Elm Yard Area Proctors Role Proctors
